author: mzf11125
content:
Hey all, combined dev update for weeks 4 to 6. Apologies for the length and the delay, a family matter kept me away, so I am catching up on all three at once.

Short version: committed to EIP-8304 (the successor to EIP-7745) in reth, built the foundational crate at `crates/ethereum/eip8304` (entry encoding, SSZ table roots, merging, table store, calldata helpers), and opened it as draft PR #26528. A self-review caught and fixed a mis-transcribed contract bytecode and added conformance vectors. One open question remains, the SSZ table list limit, which changes every root and needs the author's read. The work sits in the Pureth: Trustless Log Index area.

Next: settle the SSZ question, then start the execution-pipeline integration (fork gating and the alloy-evm boundary).

Write-up: https://hackmd.io/@mzf11125/HkHWQhnVMe
Proposal: https://hackmd.io/@mzf11125/HyASbU0Ezx
